name: Conversation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of careful and truthful speech, teaching that our words reflect the condition of our hearts and carry eternal significance. Jesus warns that every idle word will be judged, and that our words can justify or condemn us, highlighting the power of conversation to reveal character and influence destiny. Praising God and ordering one’s conduct rightly are linked to experiencing His salvation, while believers are also instructed to avoid divisive speech that contradicts sound doctrine. Thus, conversation is portrayed as a vital expression of faith and a measure of spiritual integrity.
